Holidays by age group

A trip that fits the ages you've actually got

A holiday that's brilliant with a baby is a bore for a 13-year-old. Tell us the ages and we'll only show you places that work.

Start with your ages

  • Babies & tots 0–3

    Cots and bottle warmers confirmed before you book, short transfers, quiet pools, pram-friendly resorts.

  • Little ones 4–7

    Kids clubs that genuinely take 4-year-olds, shallow splash zones, early teas, entertainment before bedtime.

  • Big kids 8–12

    Waterparks and slides, sports academies, all-inclusive so the fourth ice cream isn't a negotiation.

  • Teens 13+

    Proper wifi, teen hangouts away from the toddler disco, watersports, and enough going on that they leave their room.

Real people, real opinions

You'll speak to someone who's done the flight with a toddler

“I won't sell you a hotel I wouldn't take my own kids to. If the kids club is really a cupboard with a telly, I'll tell you — and find you somewhere better.”
  • No 6am departures unless you ask for them
  • Transfers under 90 minutes — or we flag it before you book
  • Kids club ages re-checked with the hotel the week you travel
  • One total price — luggage, transfers and seats together included
